fixes.title: Status reports say who acts and how
fixes.text: Every status report says whether it is ok, a warning, held or failed, and who has to act. A configuration problem comes with its solution in plain steps.

fixes.title: Hourly status and every update reported
fixes.text: The status report goes every hour with the setup checks, and every update run is reported.
